items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: In the audience that night I remember was Preston Foster...no, Robert Preston, that's the one, and Ava Gardner and Turon(?) Bey(?), and all kind of musicians and celebrities.

ctx.x: And during this period there was a lot of the movie stars frequenting the Jazz scene, like the after-hour places. The Streets of Paris, Sonny Tufts, he was popular at the time. He was one of our big patrons. You know, he'd show up. And when we'd go on to other places, guys like Torin(?) Bey, and Ava Gardner and her gang, and Herb Jeffries -- all kind of different stars would show up on the scene.
